# ============================================================================
#  External Agent Skills — upstream manifest
#
#  Third-party skills vendored into external/ from their upstream git repos.
#  These use the Agent Skill format (a directory with SKILL.md, plus optional
#  references/ and workflows/), NOT this repo's flat slash-command format, so
#  they install to ~/.claude/skills/<name>/ instead of ~/.claude/commands/.
#
#  Format — one skill per line, pipe-delimited, no spaces around the pipes:
#
#     name|repo-url|ref|subpath
#
#     name     Local directory name under external/, and the installed skill
#              name (invoked as /name in Claude Code). Must be unique across
#              the whole manifest — sync-external.sh refuses duplicates.
#     repo-url Git URL to clone from.
#     ref      Branch or tag to track.
#     subpath  Path inside the repo to the directory containing SKILL.md.
#              Use "." if SKILL.md sits at the repo root.
#
#  Add a line, then run:  ./scripts/sync-external.sh <name>
#  Update everything:     ./scripts/sync-external.sh
#  See what's behind:     ./scripts/sync-external.sh --check
#
#  Entries are grouped by upstream repo. A sync clones each repo once no matter
#  how many skills it contributes, so grouping costs nothing but readability.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill — MIT
#  Runs an Instagram account end to end: reels, captions, carousels, stories,
#  profile audit, weekly plan, comments/DMs, repurposing, post-mortems, plus a
#  humanizer that strips AI slop before anything reaches a draft. Five of the
#  thirteen ship offline Python tools (hook scoring, beat sheets, slop
#  detection); no API key and nothing posts on its own.
#  Every skill reads ~/.claude/instagram/voice.md — the voice profile is not
#  part of any skill directory, so it is not vendored. Upstream's blank
#  template lives at templates/voice.md in the source repo.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
